summary: The StudentPreSafety user control is a component within the HSPnet application, designed to handle student prerequisite safety data. It operates by interacting with various controls on a web page, handling data updates, and rendering UI elements appropriately based on user interaction and data conditions.
purpose: The purpose of the StudentPreSafety component is to manage and display student safety prerequisite information, handle updates, and ensure that data is correctly processed and displayed in the user interface.

workflows.name: DataBinding Workflow
steps: Select student prerequisite data based on session and student ID
Translate display fields based on user session language

workflows.name: Item Command Handling
steps: Switch to edit mode if cmdEdit is triggered
Bind student ID to detail view

workflows.name: Detail Data Binding
steps: Bind data to controls in the detail view
Handle visibility and translation of fields

workflows.name: Update Workflow
steps: Get new values from form controls

business_rules: Hide save button if screen is not editable
Only show detail modal for valid student IDs
validations: Cancel update if page is not valid
conditions: Check if CRCStatus is not 'Unknown' and not empty to show control
Toggle visibility of controls based on data status
system_behavior: Translate fields if alternative language is selected
Redirect to Safety page after update
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is null
